options.text: $5 \sqrt{15} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, making an angle of $\tan ^{-1} 4$ with - ve $Y$ axis

$5 \sqrt{17} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, making an angle of $\tan ^{-1} 4$ with + ve $X$ axis
